name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Speed the first visible 5wCal frame after V0.73 measured T=826 ms, D=629 ms, C=156 ms. Keep the deferred 35-day holiday batch, but make the initial frame cheaper: generate day numbers/today index with integer calendar arithmetic, cache cell geometry, fill weekday/body backgrounds by large regions, draw the grid as shared lines instead of 35 rectangles, keep the proven built-in 6x8 digits, and prebuild the seven Japanese weekday glyphs as tiny 1-bit images at app startup. Add component timing C/W/K/G/R for page data, clear+widgets, weekday row, body, and top header.
